archetypes.name: merge-race
archetypes.rationale: The change reclassifies ambiguous GitHub merge diagnostics before reviewDecision lookup.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the merge failure classification path for admin plus fallback failures. Check that conflict wording wins only for merge-attempt failures and that review-only or no-admin-fallback cases keep their previous behavior. Pay close attention to ordering before reviewDecision and preservation of diagnostic text. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
